summary: Bragg Gaming Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Material Change Report announcing the closing of a non-brokered private placement of 751,445 subscription receipts at US$1.73 each for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately US$1.3 million. The subscription receipts are escrowed pending release conditions linked to a previously announced acquisition; upon release, each converts into one common share and one warrant exercisable at US$2.16 for 36 months. Insiders, including the CFO, COO, and a director, participated. The offering is a financing tied to an acquisition, not a standalone special situation.
